Folckerus Everardus, & Andreas Sinæus pro Stellinguerfiis Occidentalibus; Ey-

Prætor, Hanco Nicolaus, & Tiebbo Sanmius pro Enguerdiis, Douwo Pastor
Leppenbusanus, Focco Teius Prætor, & Vitus Brunius pro Opsteranis. Notum
facimus: Quandoquidem Frisiæ Ordinibus de voluntate
Caroli Cæsaris Do-mini nostri Clementissimi, placuit Illustrissimum Philippum Principem
Hispa-niarum, utriusque Siciliæ, & Hierosolymæ, Archiducem Austriæ, Ducem
Burgundiæ & Brabantiæ, Comitem Habspurgi, Flandriæ, Hollandiæ, Domi-
num Frisiæ, unicum Cæsareæ Majestatis filium, ut verum heredem declara-
re, ac pro eo, à morte Caroli Patris, in successorem recipiendo fidem jura-
mentumque interponere, ita nos prædicto nomine & de mandato Ordinum
No-bili viro Ioanni Lignæo Comiti Arembergio, Equiti Aurei Velleris, & Cæsa-
reæ Majestatis per Frisiam, Trans-Isulaniam & Groningam
Præfecto, jus-jurandum fecimus hoc modo:
Nos Delegati Præsulum, Religiosorum, Nobilium, Oppidorum, Proprie-
tariorumque Frisiæ, fidem facimus nos Carolo Cæsare (cui Deus longam
felicemque vitam largiatur) humanis exempto Illustrissimo Duci, & Domino Phi-lip-

page.notes: Date in the left margin printed in old numerals (clɔ. Iɔ. = MDLV). The catchword "lip-" is read from the hyphenated word at the foot and is doubtful. The whole text is set in italic type; italic is marked as one run. The line-end hyphens are kept as printed.
